name: t38_cc_identity_scene_a
prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the single male person represented by the source identity image. Use this subject only for stable facial identity, head shape, eyes, nose, mouth, ears, skin tone, hairstyle, and any eyewear visibly belonging to the person. Ignore the source photograph's wall, lighting, clothing, logo, pose, and camera angle.
<Subject 2> is the empty minimalist studio represented by the scene image. Use this subject only for the fixed background layout, neutral gray wall treatment, soft frontal lighting, and studio spatial appearance.

summary:
[reference generation] Generate a single-person studio video using <Subject 1> as the identity reference and <Subject 2> as the fixed environment reference. The identity and environment have separate responsibilities.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve one consistent male identity, facial proportions, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, and visible eyewear; ignore unrelated source background, clothing, logo, pose, and lighting.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the neutral studio background, wall layout, soft frontal lighting, and fixed spatial environment.

detailed_description:
The target video is a restrained photorealistic studio portrait designed to test identity retention from a single compact reference photograph. The composition is simple and controlled, with natural skin texture, neutral colors, soft frontal illumination, and an uncluttered gray studio. The camera remains locked in a medium head-and-torso composition at eye level. There is one visible person only. No scene change, no cut, no camera movement, and no additional reference subject should compete with the identity test.
[Shot 1] At the beginning, the single male presenter from <Subject 1> is centered and faces the camera inside <Subject 2>. Preserve his facial identity, head shape, eyes, nose, mouth, ears, skin tone, hairstyle, and any eyewear that is part of his visible appearance. Do not copy the source photograph's original wall, clothing, logo, pose, crop, or lighting. Dress him in a plain dark neutral collared shirt with no logo or distinctive pattern. Keep the upper torso centered and the crop unchanged for the complete shot.

For the first part of the shot he holds a calm neutral expression and looks directly into the lens. He then makes one small natural nod and briefly shifts his gaze toward screen-left before returning to the lens. His head and shoulders remain in the same position and scale; the action must not cause a zoom, reframing, body-shape change, eyewear change, or wardrobe change. The person's facial identity remains the only identity variable under test. <Subject 2> remains unchanged behind him: keep the empty neutral-gray studio, soft frontal illumination, and fixed wall geometry. Do not add furniture, windows, screens, text, logos, props, animals, a second person, or a new location. Do not pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, roll, or cut. Keep the presenter visible from beginning to end.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet indoor studio room tone with subtle breath and very soft natural clothing movement. No identifiable dialogue, no crowd, no sound effects, and no environmental transition.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
